description: 新北市抗旱水井 [drought] is a dataset listed in Government Open Data Platform of Taiwan (data.gov.tw), an open data portal, published or maintained by 新北市政府水利局. 本市目前計有7口抗旱水井(管徑400mm)，為水利署91年度於本市樹林區所施作，有5口位於樹林省民公園，現由本府教育局體育處及水利署第十河川局管理，另有2口位於樹林河濱公園，為本府高灘地管理處管轄範圍。. Coverage: 新北市政府水利局. The portal files it under the publisher 新北市政府水利局. Its tags are 公共資訊. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2026-08-03 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Chinese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is 政府資料開放授權條款-第1版. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure hazard and exposure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-tw-dgt-portal.
